title: Health & Postcodes Adventure
welcome_lead: Your postcode can shape how long you live. 🏥
meta_desc: Inequality in the UK Adventure 2 — KS3 Sociology on health inequality and postcode lottery.
final_note: You learned how location, class and health are tied together in the UK.

walkthroughs.body_html:
In the UK, men in poorer areas live about 10 years less than men in richest areas.

That's called the postcode lottery.

Causes of health inequality:

  • Poorer housing.
  • Cheaper, less healthy food.
  • More stress.
  • Less green space.
  • Polluted air.

The NHS is free at point of use, but cannot fix everything.

Wider help:

  • Better housing.
  • Healthy school meals.
  • Clean air laws.
  • Mental health support.

Health follows fairness. 💚

options: A self-fulfilling prophecy is when teachers predict the future accurately.
Different ethnic groups have different innate abilities.

mcqs.q: What is a self-fulfilling prophecy in education?
options: Humans need no social input to develop normally.
A self-fulfilling prophecy is when a student predicts their own grade correctly.

When teachers' expectations (often based on labels) influence pupil behaviour and achievement — pupils labelled as 'bright' tend to do better, those labelled 'thick' worse, regardless of underlying ability (Rosenthal and Jacobson).
A self-fulfilling prophecy is when teachers predict the future accurately.
